text: Did you know that over 70% of cervical cancer in women from the Federal States of Micronesia (FSM) were diagnosed at the late stage?
This is a startling number since up to 90% of cervical cancers are treatable.
What’s also alarming is that most cases of this disease are diagnosed in women 36 to 64 years old, which means they could’ve been prevented through early vaccination and screening.
The HPV vaccine can prevent 9 out of 10 cases of the most high-risk strains of HPV, which is the number 1 cause of cervical cancer.
